summary: First-finish frontend smoke test for the static Trading Academy React app. Verified landing, WhatsApp floating button, login (student & admin), modules + lesson iframe, live session (offline/on-air), protected routes, admin CRUD (students/modules/lessons/live URL/credentials), invalid login, duplicate username handling, invalid YouTube URL toast, and unknown-route fallback. All primary flows work.
passed: Landing page loads with brand 'Your Trading Academy' and market ticker
WhatsApp floating button visible on landing/login/modules/live/admin with href starting https://wa.me/
Login page shows Student and Admin portal tabs
Modules page shows 3+ module-card-item items; clicking lesson-item-button loads video-player-frame iframe
Header shows nav-modules-link and nav-live-session-link for student; nav-admin-link hidden
Live page shows live-stream-status-badge = Offline and 'no live session' state by default
nav-logout-button clears session and redirects to /#/login
Admin Students tab: add student (fill 3 inputs + admin-add-student-button) appears in admin-students-table; remove works
Duplicate student username is rejected (only 1 'student' row remains)
Admin Content tab: add module + add lesson with valid YouTube URL works; invalid URL triggers YouTube error toast
Admin Live tab: paste URL + toggle live + update saves; student sees live-embed-frame with 'On Air' badge
Admin Settings tab: change admin username/password, re-login with new creds succeeds

success_rate.backend: N/A (static app, no backend by design)

notes: Initial test script assumed a separate submit button for add-student; actual UX fills the inputs on the tab and uses admin-add-student-button directly. Retest confirmed all admin flows work. No blockers.
